paper_title: 1.4 Million Open-Source Distilled Reasoning Dataset to Empower Large   Language Model Training
caption: Distribution of reference answers and test cases in the dataset. Among the entries, 38.9% have reference answers, 21.9% include test cases, and 39.2% have neither reference answers nor test cases.
model_annotation: The pie chart presents the distribution of dataset entries by whether they include a reference answer and/or a test case, showing three categories in total. The chart has three slices: “Null” (colored light red/pink) labeled at approximately 39.2%, “Have reference answer” (colored blue) labeled at approximately 38.9%, and “Have test case” (colored light green) labeled at approximately 21.9%. A legend appears in the upper-left listing the same three categories with corresponding colors and counts (Null 549,238; Have reference answer 543,935; Have test case 306,818), and the slice labels with percentages are placed outside the pie. No slices are exploded or otherwise visually emphasized, and the segments do not appear to be arranged in a clear ascending or descending order by size.
